prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet, smooth cartoon illustration mode for original Rogue.
GENERATE TWELVE NEW ILLUSTRATIONS using the supplied image ONLY as the character design/style reference. Do not copy/paste or cut/move pieces of the source. Newly DRAW all poses with natural anatomy and complete connected contours. This is a new animation sheet, NOT a pixel edit, NOT pixel art.
Character identity MUST match this exact supplied hero: tiny squat chibi adventurer, large rounded head, short chestnut-brown fringe under a loose moss-green pointed hood, simple pale round face, two short dark vertical eyes and angular brows, green tunic/scarf and flowing green cape, brown leather gloves and boots, brown belt with square gold buckle, silver short sword with gold crossguard held on the RIGHT side of the picture. No shield. No silver helmet or metal body armor. Keep exactly the reference's simple flat fantasy cartoon, thick near-black rounded outlines, muted green/brown colors, minimal shading, clean readable shapes. Do not add detailed fingers, highlights, patterns, accessories, face features, logos or a different art style.
Layout: EXACTLY 3 equal columns x 4 equal rows, 12 distinct newly drawn full-body poses. Row 1 IDLE: alert relaxed stance with sword slightly low, breathing pose with cape lifting slightly, settled stance with shifted weight. Row 2 WALK: left foot forward/right arm back, passing step, right foot forward/right arm forward; genuine articulated leg changes. Row 3 ATTACK: sword drawn back/up for wind-up, clear forward/downward sword swing to the RIGHT, returning sword to guard. Row 4 HURT: impact recoil with shoulders back, crouched stagger with bent knees, regaining stance. EVERY first frame also differs in pose from the source image. Preserve the same face, hood, clothing, sword, stocky proportions and general three-quarter right-facing view across ALL frames.
Each entire pose, sword and cape stays wholly within its own square cell, occupying about 70% of its width/height, with at least 12% transparent padding on every side. No touching adjacent cells, no cropped swords/capes/feet. Consistent character size and foot baseline. Make motion expressive but retain original simple design. Output ONLY the sheet on actual alpha transparency, no background, no ground shadows, no grid, no labels, no text, no checkerboard painted into image. Canvas aspect ratio exactly 3:4.
